name: Whisper (Starlight Dagger)
description: Kaelen's signature silent blade forged from folded meteoric starlight glass.
flavorText: A blade that cuts not the skin, but the reflection of one's breath.
effectDescription: Silences footstep audio by 50%; backstabs deal 300% damage to unaware sentries.

name: Daybreak Solar Greatsword
description: The massive consecrated blade of the Paladins of the Radiant Aegis, blessed with pure un-corrupted dawn light.
flavorText: When the sun falls behind the glass, the righteous must carry dawn upon their shoulders.
effectDescription: Strikes instantly dispel phantom illusions in a 3-meter sweep; deals +50% bonus radiant damage against Phantasmal Templars.

name: The Minotaur's Brass Labrys
description: A steam-powered double-headed battleaxe recovered from Asterion the Brass-Horned in the Daedalian Labyrinth.
flavorText: Every swing vents scalding vapor, groaning with eighty years of subterranean sorrow.
effectDescription: Charge attack creates a directional steam shockwave that knocks back heavy automaton guards and fractures brittle stone walls.

name: Iron Nails of Grounding
description: Cold-forged iron nails that pin impossible optical staircases and non-Euclidean angles to terrestrial physics.
flavorText: The mind may dream of sideways skies, but cold iron remembers the earth.
effectDescription: Permanent tool. Anchor impossible architecture in Relativity Cloister and reverse-entropy keystones.

name: Echo Bell of Vaelor
description: A bronze handbell tuned to the natural acoustic harmonic frequency of Veilkeep.
flavorText: Sound cannot be lied to. False glass shivers when true metal rings.
effectDescription: Triggers acoustic resonance puzzles, reveals invisible hollow walls, and synchronizes with wind-baffle harps.

name: Truth Lens Monocle
description: A brass monocle ground from natural Icelandic spar crystal that strips magical illusion disguises.
flavorText: Through this glass, gold turns to dross, walls turn to mist, and smiling faces reveal the clockwork beneath.
effectDescription: Hold [Space] to activate Veil Sight: dissolves false walls, reveals true pit traps, and exposes mimic chests.

name: Luminescent Memory Thread
description: A spool of un-decaying luminescent silk spun from condensed starlight fibers.
flavorText: Tie it to the threshold, lest your footsteps forget the doorway that bore you.
effectDescription: Unspools behind Kaelen to prevent spatial displacement in shifting maze corridors.

name: The Maestro's Chrono-Metronome
description: A precision clockwork rhythm regulator crafted by Maestro Niccolò in the Harmonic Conservatory.
flavorText: When time itself falters, the pulse of the heart remains true.
effectDescription: +50% combat parry window; completely silences footstep noise; 3-beat cadence charges a 360° sonic stun pulse.

name: Spectral Spirit-Lantern
description: An ornate silver gas lantern burning with pale violet ectoplasmic ghost-light.
flavorText: Turn the wick, and the dead shall cast shadows once more.
effectDescription: Projects a cone of ghost-light revealing invisible ethereal pathways and forcing poltergeists to manifest.

name: Cloak of the Sky-Sovereign
description: A regal mantle woven from the shed golden plumes of Lord Aurelius the Aether-Gryphon.
flavorText: The sky does not fall; it merely awaits those with the courage to claim its updrafts.
effectDescription: Grants mid-air gliding on thermal updrafts, absolute fall damage immunity, and silent aerial landings.

name: Ariadne's Starlight Clew
description: An unbreakable luminescent silk cord provided by Ariadne the Clockwork Weaver.
flavorText: The Minotaur roars in darkness, but the thread remembers dawn.
effectDescription: Pins hydraulic shifting labyrinth walls to guide bollards, establishing a permanent safe thoroughfare.

name: The Martyr's Starlight Amulet
description: Infused with the sacrificial life-spark of Eldrin the Star-Carver in the Abyssal Prison Block.
flavorText: A dying ember passed from caged hands to guide a free thief through the deepest dark.
effectDescription: Permanent Starlight Veil: dispels pitch-black shadow mists, grants immunity to dark-drain environmental hazards, and allows entry to the Abyssal Core.

name: The Grand Seneschal's Master Passkey
description: The master brass passkey entrusted to Grand Butler Mister Bartholomew Sterling.
flavorText: Every cupboard, pantry, and linen dumbwaiter opens to the keeper of household decorum.
effectDescription: Unlocks all fortress dumbwaiter chutes, pantry cupboards, and cellar vaults across all 27 zones.

name: Bartholomew's Imperial Earl Grey
description: A steaming porcelain cup of masterfully brewed bergamot tea, served at precisely 85°C.
flavorText: One does not conquer an archillusionist without proper hydration.
effectDescription: Restores 50 HP and 30 FP; grants +15% parry and rhythm timing accuracy for 10 minutes.

name: Sun-Blessed Consecration Oil
description: Golden aromatic oil pressed from the celestial sunflowers of the Dreaming Gardens and blessed by the Radiant Aegis.
flavorText: Wipes away decades of mirror grime and cold deceit.
effectDescription: Used to cleanse calcified prism mirrors; coats weapon in holy fire for 3 minutes (+20 radiant damage).

name: Clockwork Tension Lockpick
description: A tempered steel pick and tension wrench set calibrated for Victorian tumbler locks.
flavorText: Every closed door is merely a conversation waiting to be finished.
effectDescription: Allows attempting lockpick mini-games on chest and door tumblers.

name: I. The Shard of the Gate
description: A prismatic glass shard from Cynthia's music box. Unlocks the memory of young Cynthia slipping Kaelen his first lockpick set.
flavorText: I won't tell father, Kaelen. Just promise you'll pick the lock when it's time to run away.
effectDescription: Permanently increases lockpicking speed by +15%.

name: II. The Shard of the Hearth
description: Unlocks the memory of Cook Hesta baking honey rolls while young Kaelen and Cynthia hide under the baker's table.
flavorText: Warm bread and quiet laughter before the mirrors came.
effectDescription: Resting restores full health and grants +10 max stamina for 20 minutes.

name: III. The Shard of the Glass
description: Unlocks the memory of Vaelor conjuring the very first phantasmal hound as a loyal guard dog to delight his bedridden child.
flavorText: See, little bird? Glass does not bite unless I tell it to.
effectDescription: Phantasmal Hounds hesitate 1.5 seconds before attacking Kaelen.

name: IV. The Shard of the Garden
description: Unlocks the memory of Cynthia planting midnight lilies in the Dreaming Gardens.
flavorText: If I believe they will grow without sunlight, will they listen to me?
effectDescription: Increases max FP by +15 and immunity to floral sleep spores.

name: V. The Shard of the Spire
description: Unlocks the memory of Vaelor locking the Spire escapement to halt the fortress clock.
flavorText: If the second hand does not advance, she cannot grow weaker.
effectDescription: +10% dodge invulnerability frames.

name: VI. The Shard of the Crypt
description: Unlocks the memory of Cynthia's secret descent into the Undercrypt to lay flowers on the monks' tombs.
flavorText: Even stone sleepers get lonely in the cold.
effectDescription: Reveals hidden crypt illusions without consuming Truth Lens charges.

name: VII. The Shard of the Labyrinth
description: The final central cylinder of Cynthia's music box recovered from Asterion the Minotaur.
flavorText: The lullaby is complete. The song can finally end.
effectDescription: Unlocks the True Dawn Ending when confronting Vaelor.

name: Retrograde Ouroboros
description: An enchanted bronze serpent consuming its own tail in reverse.
flavorText: What has happened will un-happen, if the coil is turned backwards.
effectDescription: Records 8 seconds of locomotion; activate to spawn a controllable Temporal Echo that distracts sentries.

name: Hourglass of Inverted Sands
description: An hourglass filled with purple tachyon sand that falls upward toward the top bulb.
flavorText: Gravity is merely an opinion held by the forward-facing.
effectDescription: Enables backward locomotion to rebuild fractured architectural bridges.

name: The Cogito Ring
description: A silver signet ring inscribed with Doctor Renatus's radical proof: 'Cogito, Ergo Sum'.
flavorText: I doubt, therefore I think; I think, therefore I am.
effectDescription: +2 INT; reduces duration of Confused and Illusion debuffs by 50%.

name: Tuning Fork of Unmaking
description: A heavy brass tuning fork calibrated to the dissonant frequency of Vaelor's sensory wards.
flavorText: Strike true, and the phantom dissolves into vibration.
effectDescription: Strike near illusory sentries to instantly shatter their physical projection.

name: The Meditations of Doctor Renatus
description: Bound vellum pages containing the philosopher's complete treatises on the Malicious Demon.
flavorText: Even the most cunning deceiver cannot make me nothing while I think I am something.
effectDescription: +20% critical strike chance when attacking illusion clones and mirage bosses.

name: Spellweaver's Bracers
description: Silk and brass vambraces awarded by the Apostate Mages of the Thaumaturges' Enclave.
flavorText: Starlight channeled through fingertips rather than wands.
effectDescription: Reduces FP cost of Arcane Trickster spells by 25%.

name: Aether-Pigeon Whistle
description: A carved bone whistle tuned to the ultrasonic flight calls of Imperial Aether-Pigeons.
flavorText: The sky remembers the message even when the sender is forgotten.
effectDescription: Summons Zephyr the falcon to retrieve distant keys or drop smoke bombs on sentries.

name: Sterling's Silver Pocket Watch
description: An engraved silver half-hunter pocket watch kept by Grand Butler Mister Bartholomew Sterling.
flavorText: A gentleman is never early, nor is he late. He strikes precisely when the kettle chimes.
effectDescription: +15% parry and rhythm timing window; displays HUD real-time day/night soft clock.

name: Madame Vivienne's Mourning Cameo
description: A jet-black carved onyx cameo brooch worn by the spectral governess of the Pale Nursery.
flavorText: Sleep, little one. The storm outside cannot touch you here.
effectDescription: +15 Ethereal Def; upon taking fatal damage, triggers 2.5s of invulnerable spirit mist (5 min cooldown).

name: Pneumatic Harpoon Grapple
description: A steam-actuated grapnel winch with high-tensile braided wire.
flavorText: Piston-driven reaching for heights that honest ladders cannot touch.
effectDescription: Grapple to overhead steam pipes, parapet copings, and high ventilation grates.

name: Houyhnhnm's Horseshoe
description: A gilded horseshoe gifted by Lord Barnaby the Astrological Talking Horse.
flavorText: A token from a nobleman who happens to have four legs and exceptional breeding.
effectDescription: +10% sprint speed, +1 Luck (increases rare loot drops).

name: Aether-Silk Wing Glider
description: Collapsible silk wings designed by the rooftop Windkeeper.
flavorText: Catch the thermal chimney, and the entire keep becomes a descending staircase.
effectDescription: Glide across exterior fortress chasms on thermal wind updrafts.

name: Voidwoven Cloak
description: A heavy velvet mantle soaked in the midnight mist of the Void Realm.
flavorText: Darkness wraps you in its folds until even your thoughts cast no shadow.
effectDescription: Complete immunity to the Confused status effect; silent rolling.

name: The Champion's Sigil
description: A heavy brass badge earned by triumphing in the Veil Colosseum.
flavorText: Blood spilled on illusionary sand leaves an indelible mark.
effectDescription: +1 STR; unlocks the one-way Colosseum shortcut descending directly into the Undercrypt.

name: Gatehouse Portcullis Key
description: Heavy iron key carried by Gatekeeper Orin.
flavorText: Opens the inner barbican into the domestic quarters.
effectDescription: Unlocks the main Gatehouse portcullis.

name: Warden's Abyssal Keyring
description: Brass and cold-iron keyring taken from Siphon Warden Malakor.
flavorText: Chirps like a bird of prey when brought near isolation cells.
effectDescription: Unlocks all cell gates in the Abyssal Prison Block.

name: Gatehouse Portcullis Key
description: Heavy iron key carried by Gatekeeper Orin and the Barbican Captain.
flavorText: Opens the inner barbican into the domestic quarters.
effectDescription: Unlocks the main Gatehouse portcullis.

name: Volatile Sulfur Pouch
description: A thumbed leather pouch of Greyport brimstone, saltpetre and glass dust.
flavorText: The Gutter-Alchemist never asks whether a lock wants to open. He asks whether it wants to burn.
effectDescription: Synthesises Acid Vials that melt Grade-3 brass locks silently.

name: Stolen Guard Tabard
description: A gatehouse tabard still smelling of rain, lamp oil and someone else's rank.
flavorText: Nobody looks twice at a uniform. That is the entire trick.
effectDescription: Social Disguise: patrols treat Kaelen as a relief guard in plain sight.

name: Dockside Knuckle Plate
description: Pitted brass over scarred knuckles, worn smooth by fourteen years of dockyard disputes.
flavorText: Greyport has a long and distinguished tradition of arguing with fists.
effectDescription: +25% stagger on heavy and unarmed strikes.

name: Occult Reliquary Lens
description: A jeweller's loupe set in a bone frame, ground to see the seams in cursed things.
flavorText: Every relic has a lie in it. The lens shows you which part is breathing.
effectDescription: Reveals hidden doors and cursed relics within 8 m; halves curse penalties.

name: Calibrated Brass Cog
description: A palm-sized foundry cog stamped with the Vane calibration mark.
flavorText: A gear is only a promise that something, somewhere, will move exactly this much.
effectDescription: Jams boiler soot vents and drives the Gatehouse steam-piston bypass.
